implementation.ingress: Existing Stella normal group trigger with explicit !ligamina marker; native reply matcher is blocked for this marker to avoid duplicate send
implementation.core_contract: loopback Core event, Gateway lease, claim and result routes
implementation.outbound: Stella core.transport.outbound.OutboundService with the active matching OneBot Bot; no direct SnowLuma calls
implementation.target_scope: configured client/account/Host and intersection of explicit bridge groups with Stella ALLOWED_GROUPS
implementation.unknown_policy: partial, timeout, exception, and unknown outcomes remain unknown and are not replayed
implementation.correlation_logs: operation begin, outbound begin, and terminal logs include sanitized operation/event/trace identifiers; no group ID, message body, or credentials

commands: disabled stdlib-only import from Ligamina client path

git_diff_check.notes: CRLF normalization warnings only for pre-existing modified feature_list.json, progress.md and session-handoff.md

next_action: In private local launch configuration, set the documented STELLA_LIGAMINA_* values using the registered Core client and Gateway credentials; ensure the loopback Core and selected target Host are ready; restart the existing Stella process to load the staged extension; then send one fresh authorized @Stella !ligamina echo <unique-marker> group message and capture Core, Host, operation, Stella outbound, receiver and cleanup evidence.

decision.conclusion: The connector is locally verified and staged, but private configuration and a controlled reload are still required. Stella-native reply evidence is not Ligamina field acceptance.
